events.title: Eaton's Q1 Earnings and Revenues Surpass Estimates, Guidance Raised
events.body: ETN tops Q1 estimates as revenues jump 17% and EPS rises 3%; it has lifted 2026 adjusted EPS guidance and sees 9-11% organic growth.

events.title: Is ABB (ABBNY) Outperforming Other Industrial Products Stocks This Year?
events.body: Here is how ABB (ABBNY) and CECO Environmental (CECO) have performed compared to their sector so far this year.

events.title: CNH Q1 Earnings Meet Estimates, Revenues Beat on Favorable Pricing
events.body: CNH posts in-line Q1 earnings as pricing and FX lift revenues, but tariffs and costs squeeze margins across Agriculture and Construction.
